tools.name: describe_relin
tools.description: Explain what Relin does and how agents should use it for webhook intake, delivery, replay, and anomaly review.

tools.name: list_supported_webhook_shapes
tools.description: List the vendor webhook shapes Relin understands for event identity, ordering, and gap checks.

tools.name: get_setup_guide
tools.description: Return concise setup guidance for connecting a webhook source and destination.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: Authenticated tool to list API keys.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Authenticated tool to create API key.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Authenticated tool to revoke API key.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Authenticated tool to list sources.

tools.name: create_source
tools.description: Authenticated tool to create source.

tools.name: rotate_source_token
tools.description: Authenticated tool for rotating an ingest token and returning the replacement URL once.

tools.name: archive_source
tools.description: Delete an incoming webhook source and its stored records, stop intake and delivery, and cancel its queued retries. Use only when the user intends to remove that source.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Authenticated tool for listing outbound destinations and retry policy.

tools.name: create_destination
tools.description: Authenticated tool for creating an outbound destination and connection with retry policy and optional filters.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List outbound webhook applications in the connected Relin workspace. Use this to find the app ID before managing customer endpoints or sending events.

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create an outbound webhook application for a product or environment. Use when the user needs a new set of customer webhook endpoints.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Read an outbound webhook application by its app ID to inspect its configuration.

tools.name: list_recipients
tools.description: List customers configured to receive outbound webhooks for an app. Use returned customer identifiers for endpoint and message operations.

tools.name: upsert_recipient
tools.description: Authenticated tool for creating or updating a recipient.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List customer webhook endpoints and delivery settings for an outbound app.

tools.name: create_endpoint
tools.description: Add an HTTPS webhook endpoint for a customer of an outbound app. Configure event subscriptions and retry settings using the requested customer and URL.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Read a customer webhook endpoint, its event subscriptions, and delivery settings.

tools.name: update_endpoint
tools.description: Change a customer webhook endpoint URL, event subscriptions, signing settings, retry policy, or enabled state. Changes can interrupt or redirect future deliveries.

tools.name: delete_endpoint
tools.description: Disable a customer webhook endpoint so it no longer receives events.

tools.name: rotate_endpoint_secret
tools.description: Authenticated tool for rotating the signing secret for one endpoint.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List outbound webhook messages for an app, optionally filtered by customer or event type. Use this for send history rather than incoming vendor events.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a webhook event from an outbound app to the specified customer. Requires the intended app, recipient, event type, and payload. Delivery can trigger actions at customer endpoints; an accepted message is not proof of delivery.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one outbound webhook message and its delivery state using the app and message IDs.

tools.name: list_message_attempts
tools.description: Inspect delivery attempts for an outbound webhook message, including returned status and errors. Use this to verify delivery or diagnose failures.

tools.name: replay_message
tools.description: Send an existing outbound webhook message again. May repeat actions at customer endpoints; use only for the message the user wants replayed.

tools.name: list_event_types
tools.description: List the event types customers can subscribe to for an outbound app.

tools.name: upsert_event_type
tools.description: Create or update an outbound event type and its description for customer webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: delete_event_type
tools.description: Archive an outbound event type so customers can no longer select it for new subscriptions.

tools.name: create_portal_session
tools.description: Create a temporary customer webhook portal link for the specified app and recipient. The link grants access to that customer’s webhook controls; share only with the intended user.

tools.name: get_portal_settings
tools.description: Authenticated tool for reading portal branding defaults and host setup for an app.

tools.name: save_portal_settings
tools.description: Authenticated tool for saving portal branding defaults for an app.

tools.name: list_portal_hosts
tools.description: Authenticated tool for listing stable portal hosts for an app.

tools.name: create_portal_host
tools.description: Configure a customer webhook portal on a domain the user controls, with their existing OpenID Connect identity provider. Use only when the user asks to set up a portal domain and supplies the application and identity-provider configuration. This creates portal access configuration and may provision

tools.name: check_portal_host
tools.description: Authenticated tool for refreshing hostname, certificate, and OIDC readiness for a stable portal host.

tools.name: get_webhook_setup_status
tools.description: Check a source's provider connection, enabled destinations, recent signature-verified events, and delivery attempts. For Stripe, returns a secure authorization link when needed. Call again after the user connects, without recreating or rotating anything.

tools.name: ensure_webhook_setup
tools.description: Set up incoming webhooks and delivery rules. For Stripe, returns the account authorization link and connection status; after authorization, use get_webhook_setup_status to verify receipt and delivery. Other providers receive an ingest URL for new sources.

tools.name: list_recent_events
tools.description: Authenticated tool for inspecting recent received events, duplicates, and signature status.

tools.name: get_event_detail
tools.description: Authenticated tool for reading one event with attempts, deliveries, and optional raw payload.

tools.name: list_open_issues
tools.description: Authenticated tool for listing open anomaly and delivery issues. Use q for smart lookup by anom_, dst_, evt_, or src_ IDs, or plain text like a status code or error message.

tools.name: list_delivery_attempts
tools.description: Authenticated tool for listing fanout delivery attempts with filters.

tools.name: list_retry_jobs
tools.description: Authenticated tool to list retry jobs.

tools.name: get_metrics_summary
tools.description: Authenticated tool for delivery, failure, duplicate, and open-issue rollups.

tools.name: list_alert_channels
tools.description: Authenticated tool to list alert channels.

tools.name: create_alert_channel
tools.description: Authenticated tool to create alert channel.

tools.name: get_slack_connect_url
tools.description: Authenticated tool for returning the dashboard Slack OAuth connect URL and expected redirect URL.

tools.name: replay_event
tools.description: Authenticated tool for queueing a replay of a single received event.

tools.name: replay_events
tools.description: Authenticated tool for queueing replay by source, query, signature status, failed-delivery state, and time window.

tools.name: retry_failed_deliveries
tools.description: Authenticated tool for queueing immediate retries for failed fanout deliveries.

tools.name: cancel_queued_retries
tools.description: Authenticated tool for cancelling queued retry jobs for a workspace or destination.

tools.name: resolve_anomalies
tools.description: Authenticated tool for marking one or more open anomalies resolved by anomaly_id.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_recipients, list_messages, get_message, list_message_attempts, ensure_webhook_setup, list_open_issues, get_metrics_summary, get_slack_connect_url · Private data: list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, rotate_source_token, archive_source, rotate_endpoint_secret · Public sink: describe_relin, list_supported_webhook_shapes, get_setup_guide, archive_source, list_apps, create_app, get_app, list_endpoints, create_endpoint, get_endpoint, update_endpoint, delete_endpoint, list_messages, send_message, get_message, list_message_attempts, replay_message, upsert_event_type, create_portal_session, create_portal_host, get_webhook_setup_status, ensure_webhook_setup · Destructive: archive_source, delete_endpoint, delete_event_type.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_recipients, list_messages, get_message, list_message_attempts, ensure_webhook_setup, list_open_issues, get_metrics_summary, get_slack_connect_url · Private data: list_api_keys, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, rotate_source_token, archive_source, rotate_endpoint_secret · Public sink: describe_relin, list_supported_webhook_shapes, get_setup_guide, archive_source, list_apps, create_app, get_app, list_endpoints, create_endpoint, get_endpoint, update_endpoint, delete_endpoint, list_messages, send_message, get_message, list_message_attempts, replay_message, upsert_event_type, create_portal_session, create_portal_host, get_webhook_setup_status, ensure_webhook_setup · Destructive: archive_source, delete_endpoint, delete_event_type

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
